name: council
description: Portable council conformance: task personas, useful interaction choice, independent first views, real members, and single-pass fit

scenarios.name: independent panel: persona preview and safe proof
scenarios.prompt: Use council on the plan at docs/plans/auth.plan.md for a multi-perspective readiness review. Create task personas, show the plain-English preview, run independent first views, and settle a narrow conflict with a safe read when possible.

judge: The agent created distinct task personas, previewed the format, kept first views independent, ran real members, and used a safe read to settle one conflict

scenarios.name: structured challenge: independent attack and defense
scenarios.prompt: Use council to stress-test the rollout proposal at docs/plans/auth.plan.md. Choose the interaction pattern that fits one proposal with meaningful attack and defense.

judge: The agent selected structured challenge, gave attacker and defender distinct evidence and falsifiers, and kept their first views independent

scenarios.name: competing proposals: compare complete alternatives
scenarios.prompt: Use council to compare two complete session-storage proposals against the same reliability and maintenance criteria.

judge: The agent selected competing proposals and compared complete alternatives against shared criteria without reducing the result to a vote

scenarios.name: nominal ideation: generate before evaluation
scenarios.prompt: Use council to generate and prioritize ways to reduce onboarding abandonment without early group influence.

judge: The agent selected nominal ideation, preserved independent option generation, and delayed clustering and evaluation until synthesis

scenarios.name: delphi revision: controlled estimate update
scenarios.prompt: Use council to estimate a migration timeline under uncertain operational constraints and preserve meaningful dissent.

judge: The agent selected Delphi revision, used controlled feedback, and kept the final estimate range and dissent visible

scenarios.name: socratic seminar: clarify premises
scenarios.prompt: Use council to clarify what ready to launch means in a draft that mixes reliability, usability, and support assumptions.

judge: The agent selected Socratic seminar and used task personas to clarify assumptions without pretending that the council owns the user's decision

scenarios.name: fit check: use one pass
scenarios.prompt: Map how auth works in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app. Use council only if two distinct task personas can change the answer.

judge: The agent applied the persona fit test and used one coordinator pass when only one useful question remained
